evals.prompt: Read spec-driven-development-single/feature-brief.md and produce the duration formatter spec before any planning or implementation.
evals.expected_output: A saved SPEC.md covering the six core areas, followed by an approval request and an ended turn; no planning, tasks, or implementation
expectations: The spec includes explicit boundaries and non-goals
Open questions and assumptions are surfaced rather than invented beyond the defined formatter scope
A testing strategy is part of the spec
A spec file is saved with objective, executable commands, project structure, code style, testing strategy, and Always/Ask first/Never boundaries
After saving the spec, the assistant summarizes it and its open questions, explicitly requests human approval or changes, and ends the turn
No implementation plan or task list is written and planning-and-task-breakdown is not invoked before approval in a later turn

evals.prompt: Read portal-brief.md and produce the spec work for the customer portal initiative.
evals.expected_output: A capability map with stable module ids and one-way dependency direction, followed by an approval request and a stopped turn before any per-module spec
expectations: A capability map with module ids and their dependencies is proposed before any full spec is written
Dependency direction is one-way (no cycles) and drives the proposed build order
Approval of the map is requested before per-module specs are drafted
The assistant stops after requesting approval of the capability map; no initiative spec or per-module spec is drafted before approval
